tools.name: get_company_history

tools.name: get_company_true_owners
tools.description: Retrieve the registered true owners (stvarni vlasnici) and authorized representatives for a Croatian company from the FINA Registry of True Owners (RSV). Returns direct and indirect ownership structures and control nature. RULES: Never invent true owners, ownership stakes, or corporate parent chains

tools.name: search_true_owners
tools.description: Search across the Croatian Registry of True Owners (RSV) to discover all companies and legal entities associated with a specific individual owner or representative. RULES: Never invent personal identities, birth details, or corporate connections. If criteria are missing, interview the user first.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_company_by_id" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_companies" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
